title: 9 Best Pisum Sativum Benefits

benefits.desc: Pisum sativum acts as antioxidant because it contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and vitamin C, which neutralize free radicals in the body. These compounds help reduce oxidative stress, which is linked to various chronic diseases. The antioxidant properties of peas may alleviate conditions like cardiovascular disease, inflammation, and even age-related disorders. Regular consumption of peas can support overall cellular health and immune function.
benefits.definition: Oxidative stress is a health issue characterized by an imbalance between free radicals and the body's ability to neutralize them. This condition can be caused by environmental toxins, poor diet, and lifestyle factors such as smoking or excessive alcohol consumption. It commonly affects individuals with chronic diseases or those exposed to high levels of pollution. Pisum sativum, or the common pea, acts as an antioxidant by neutralizing free radicals and reducing oxidative damage. This plant can help support cellular health and may lower the risk of conditions linked to oxidative stress.
benefits.constituents: Pisum sativum acts as antioxidant because it contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids. These compounds neutralize free radicals in the body, reducing oxidative stress. Alkaloids like pisatin contribute to its antioxidant properties by inhibiting lipid peroxidation. Flavonoids, including quercetin and kaempferol, enhance the body's defense against oxidative damage. Together, these constituents support overall cellular health and may lower the risk of chronic diseases.
benefits.study: According to "Free radical research", Pisum sativum acts as an antioxidant in a positive way, as it has been investigated in various in vitro models and its potential in maintaining cellular redox homeostasis has been discussed in the context of its antioxidant capacity.
